title: Ok-okozati viszonyok és feltételek (Causal Relations, Conditions & Concessions)
grammar: Discourse Connectors (tehát, azonban, ráadásul) & Textual Cohesion in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can give a reason with mivel and tekintettel arra, hogy.
I can set a condition with feltéve, hogy.
I can say that something led to a result with odáig vezetett, hogy.
I can say what a condition, a concession and a cause-and-effect relationship are.
